name: inverter_air_water_heat_pump
title: Inverter air-to-water heat pump (Daikin Altherma type), heating mode
summary: Detailed steady-state model of an inverter-driven reversible air-to-water heat pump (Daikin Altherma type, 2007): inverter compressor with isentropic and isochoric compression stages, effectiveness heat exchangers, fan and pump characteristics, frost/ice correction. Heating-mode branch of the original two-mode (SUBPROGRAM) file, flattened per decision D10.

authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, file initials VLD)

verification.reference: EES stored solution (226 of 492 variables); partly self-inconsistent (condenser dew point 18.5 °C vs water heated to 42 °C), see README
verification.notes: Not verified: the native file (CS-GAP-IF5 closed, all 14 five-argument IF evaluate) solves 180 of 181 blocks but the 151-variable block 106 (dry/wet evaporator selection + compressor + condenser coupling) does not converge (Newton SingularJacobian/LineSearchFailed, TrustRegion MaxIterations, residual about 1e4 from a CoolProp-consistent initial point; register section 8, C-147). The stored EES R410A enthalpies/entropies are in EES's reference state (offset 142244.6 J/kg for h, to be added for CoolProp) and 118 of the 151 block variables are not stored; the shipped .initials is the stored solution with the reference-state offset applied and a consistent cycle point for the unstored variables. No .sol. The _coolsolve variant was removed (it never solved).
